GRID_FACTOR.ref: CEA CO2 Baseline Database, weighted average emission factor adjusted for renewables, 2023-24 (reported via SolarQuarter). Verify against the latest CEA version on cea.nic.in

TRANSPORT_T_PER_PERSON.ref: Derived: CEEW states India per-capita emissions 2.4 tCO2e and transport ~14% of national GHG; 2.4 x 0.14 = 0.34. National average, car-heavy cities are higher

residential.floorArea.ref: Assumption: design choice (about 4 floors on a 1,600 m2 footprint)

residential.embodiedKgPerM2.ref: Akshatha, Palaniappan & Rao, Embodied carbon variability in Indian high-rise residential buildings: a case-based assessment (mean of 4 databases, range 373-530)

residential.energyKwhPerM2Yr.ref: Building Energy Efficiency Through the BEE Mandate: average residential electricity use ~80 kWh/m2/yr

office.embodiedKgPerM2.ref: Assumption: no Indian office source found yet

office.energyKwhPerM2Yr.ref: BEE/UNDP-GEF presentation: national commercial building benchmark ~180 kWh/m2/yr

road.energyKwhPerM2Yr.ref: Assumption: street lighting, no source found

park.sink.ref: Assumption: half of the upper bound 3.5 t/tile, from ~6 tC/ha/yr forest rate (Ramachandra et al., Indian Forester 2017) x 0.16 ha. Urban parks absorb less than forests

solar.embodiedTotal.ref: 800 kWp x 2,569 kgCO2e/kWp (life cycle GHG of 1 kWp multi-crystalline PV, Sri Lanka study, not India-specific). 800 kWp tile size is an assumption

solar.generationMWhYr.ref: 800 kWp x 1,518 kWh/kWp/yr final yield (Singh et al., 10 MW grid-connected PV system, North India). 800 kWp tile size is an assumption

metro.embodiedKgPerM2.ref: Assumption: no source found yet (try DMRC sustainability reports)

metro.energyKwhPerM2Yr.ref: Assumption: no source found yet (try DMRC sustainability reports)

TRANSPORT_MULTIPLIER_NEAR_METRO.ref: Model assumption: residential within 3 tiles of a metro station emits 30% less transport carbon

ENERGY_MULTIPLIER_NEAR_PARK.ref: Model assumption: buildings adjacent to a park use 8% less cooling energy

industry.floorArea.ref: Design assumption: a 2×2 asset with four 1,600 m² tiles.

industry.embodiedKgPerM2.ref: Indian factory typology average for upfront life-cycle stages A1–A5 in the SED Fund / IGBC building baseline report (limited factory sample).

industry.energyKwhPerM2Yr.ref: Midpoint of the reported 58–69 kWh/m²/year EPI range for Jagadhari railway workshop buildings. Building utility benchmark only; production/process energy is not represented.

industry.cost.ref: Retained project assumption; no sufficiently comparable current construction cost was found for the modeled facility.

industry.capacity.ref: No occupancy figure supplied by the selected factory sources; industrial worker capacity is not modeled.

water.area.ref: Design assumption: a 2×2 asset with four 1,600 m² tiles.

water.embodied.ref: Construction emissions excluded because the model has no excavation, liner, bank, or bill-of-quantities specification; zero here means unmodeled, not carbon-free construction.

water.directKgPerM2Yr.ref: Calculated from the study's mean urban artificial-pond fluxes: 8.33 g CH4/m²/year × 34 (100-year GWP) + 206 g CO2/m²/year. Swedish urban-pond proxy; study sampled during daytime and did not measure ebullition, so the value is uncertain and may be low. See the Indian inland-water study for regional variability.
water.directKgPerM2Yr.relatedRef: Indian inland waters vary substantially by waterbody type; the study reports wide CH4 and CO2 flux ranges and should be treated as context, not as a directly transferable urban-pond rate.

water.cost.ref: Retained project assumption; cost depends on excavation, lining, water treatment, and site conditions, none of which are specified.

water.capacity.ref: Not applicable; water body has no population capacity in this model.

school.floorArea.ref: Design assumption: 2×2 asset made of four 1,600 m² tiles.

school.energyKwhPerM2Yr.ref: Midpoint of the published 30–40 kWh/m²/year estimated EPI range for Indian higher-secondary schools (Kumar et al., 2017).

school.cost.ref: Project cost assumption; not researched for a comparable 6,400 m² school.

hospital.floorArea.ref: Design assumption: 2×2 asset made of four 1,600 m² tiles.

hospital.energyKwhPerM2Yr.ref: Measured energy performance index for New Civil Hospital, Surat, reported in BEE's hospital energy-efficiency best-practice guide; used as a proxy, not a universal hospital benchmark.

hospital.cost.ref: Project cost assumption; not researched for a comparable 6,400 m² hospital.

wastewater.flowM3Yr.ref: Design assumption: 10 million litres/day (MLD) × 365 days/year; plant size is illustrative.

wastewater.energyKwhPerM3.ref: Average electrical energy intensity reported for Indian sewage treatment plants from primary data on 50 operating plants. Actual rates vary by scale and treatment technology.

wastewater.directKgPerM3.ref: Approximate fugitive share derived as 0.78 kgCO₂e/m³ average carbon footprint for large STPs × 74% reported fugitive-emission share. This is a proxy; treatment-specific direct emissions vary.

wastewater.cost.ref: Project cost assumption for an illustrative 10 MLD plant; not estimated from a comparable construction tender.

datacenter.itLoadMw.ref: Illustrative design assumption for a city-scale data-center asset.

datacenter.utilization.ref: Typical utilization assumption used in NITI Aayog's India data-center electricity-demand estimate.

datacenter.pue.ref: Power usage effectiveness assumption used in NITI Aayog's India data-center electricity-demand estimate; facility energy = IT load × utilization × PUE × hours.

datacenter.cost.ref: Project cost assumption; data-center capital cost depends on capacity, redundancy, and site requirements.

hotel.floorArea.ref: Design assumption: a 2×2 asset with four 1,600 m² tiles.

hotel.energyKwhPerM2Yr.ref: Published EPI benchmark for above-three-star hotels in India's composite climate zone; use is a regional proxy.

hotel.cost.ref: Illustrative project cost assumption; no comparable hotel construction estimate is modeled.

mall.floorArea.ref: Design assumption: a 2×2 asset with four 1,600 m² tiles.

mall.energyKwhPerM2Yr.ref: Midpoint of the 300–350 kWh/m²/year one-star composite-climate shopping-mall EPI band in BEE's 2022–23 impact report.

mall.cost.ref: Illustrative project cost assumption; no comparable mall construction estimate is modeled.

landfill.ch4TonnesYr.ref: IPCC-method estimate for landfill methane emissions from Chandigarh's 350-tonne/day municipal waste site.

landfill.siteScale.ref: Illustrative 10 tonnes/day facility ÷ research site's approximately 350 tonnes/day; emissions are scaled linearly as a rough proxy.

landfill.methaneGwp100.ref: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report 100-year global warming potential for biogenic methane.

landfill.cost.ref: Illustrative project cost assumption for a small landfill cell; no site-specific construction scope is modeled.

urbanforest.treeCount.ref: Illustrative planting density assumption for a 6,400 m² urban forest tile.

urbanforest.co2KgPerTreeYr.ref: Mean annual tree sequestration reported across urban green spaces in Panaji, India; not a guarantee for every species or site.

urbanforest.cost.ref: Illustrative land and planting cost assumption; site acquisition and maintenance are not specified.

wind.generationGWh.ref: India's reported wind generation for FY 2025–26 (106,699 million units, converted to GWh).

wind.installedCapacityMw.ref: India's reported installed wind capacity as of 30 June 2026; end-year capacity makes the derived capacity factor a rough proxy.

wind.cost.ref: Illustrative cost assumption for a 2 MW turbine; grid connection, access roads, and project-specific civil works are excluded.

busdepot.buses.ref: Illustrative fleet-size assumption for a neighborhood depot.

busdepot.kmPerDay.ref: Median daily distance reported for electric buses operating in Indore; applied here as an activity proxy for a diesel fleet.

busdepot.passengers.ref: Illustrative average passenger-load assumption; actual occupancy varies by route and time.

busdepot.kgPerPassengerKm.ref: India-specific intracity bus transport emissions factor derived from State Road Transport Utility activity data.

busdepot.cost.ref: Illustrative depot cost assumption; vehicle purchase and depot size are not separately modeled.
